capsuleTopic.title: Peter
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Called · impulsive · witness · denial · restoration · leadership
capsuleTopic.orientation: Follow Peter without reducing him to boldness, failure, office, or restoration. Watch how his words, actions, relationships, corrections, witness, and later memory change across the canon.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Follow Simon Peter from fishing and a new name through confession, resistance, denial, restoration, public witness, widening mission, conflict, and later Scripture memory.
